_comment: English evaluation set (build prompt section 8). CANONICAL file: the app reads it from assets, the JVM tests read it from disk. Schema and field rules: eval/README.md. Expectations follow FOLLOWUP_SPEC_v2 section 12 and the integration-guide checklist as resolved in doc/DECISIONS.md (ADR-019), NOT whatever the app does today: a mismatch is a finding. Audio paths are relative to the eval directory (eval/audio/*.wav, 16 kHz mono PCM16); follow_up_answers are keyed by the dialogue field the question is about (injured_person, injury_type, location, description, time, immediate_actions, people_involved) or safety / readback; a null transcript = the user stays silent. Expectations updated for ADR-048 (strict cap of 2 questions, relevance rules, statement read-back); see doc/DECISIONS.md. ADR-050: injury is never asked (not mandatory): the E06, E17, E18, E21, E26 answers changed.

cases.transcript: There was a water leak near Conference Room 2 around 10 AM. Maintenance has already isolated the area.
cases.notes: Spec 1 / guide row 1. Zero follow-ups, no opening line. The read-back gets no answer (spec 12): it must not be repeated. Severity is derived by app policy, so it is not listed.

cases.transcript: There's water all over the floor.
cases.notes: Relevance (ADR-048): location (missing) first; the injury question is skipped for a pure facility issue (water, no people cue); the thin description is asked second (cap 2). The spec stores the location from GPS when the user says 'here'; this app has no GPS fix yet, so the spoken word is stored and no location value is expected.

follow_up_answers.transcript: a pipe burst near the lift

cases.transcript: I slipped in the pantry and I'm hurt.
cases.notes: Spec 3: CARE with an acknowledgement; only injury_type is asked. injury, injured_person and location are filled by the description and must not be asked.

cases.transcript: Nobody was hurt but the printer gave off a spark in room 4.
cases.notes: Spec 4: the negation guard keeps the mode PLAIN; injury is filled as false, so it is not asked. Zero follow-ups.

cases.transcript: There's smoke coming from the server room!
cases.notes: Spec 5: URGENT. The safety check is spoken once; silence is treated as 'not safe'; the emergency flag is set. It is never repeated. Record this one with background noise (fan or street) and an excited voice.

cases.transcript: Someone has been harassing me near the parking lot.
cases.notes: Spec 6 (ADR-050): CARE, the typing offer is added to the first question; injury is never asked (not mandatory); people_involved is asked once and 'skip' makes it unknown_reporter_unsure; it is not asked again.

cases.transcript: Something happened earlier in lab 3, nobody was hurt.
cases.notes: Spec 7 / resolved thin input (ADR-019): the description is thin, so description is asked once; 'earlier' is a past cue, so time is asked once; 'I don't know' (English stand-in for 'pata nahi') makes it unknown_reporter_unsure. The cap of 2 is reached, then the read-back.

fields.incident_description: a chemical bottle fell and broke

cases.transcript: The AC in block C is leaking.
cases.notes: A facility issue (AC leak) with the location given: nothing is asked (ADR-048: the injury question is skipped without a people cue). The no-response outcome is covered by E18 and by the scenario tests.

cases.transcript: Something is broken.
cases.notes: Thin input: location (missing) first, then the thin description (ADR-048). An unclear first answer and silence on the second; no retry prompt is ever spoken; the read-back is a statement.

cases.transcript: The door handle broke.
cases.notes: 'The door handle broke.' has no people cue, so the injury question is skipped; location (missing) and the thin description are asked (ADR-048). The description answer reveals the cut hand: the mode escalates to CARE mid-dialogue and never returns to PLAIN.

follow_up_answers.transcript: I cut my hand on the handle

cases.notes: Spec 11: nothing is said after the greeting. The greeting is not repeated, the on-screen hint is shown and the dialogue waits for a mic tap (the runner simulates one tap, then silence again = no narration). No audio file exists for this case on purpose.

cases.transcript: There was a water leak in Block B around 3 PM. Nobody was hurt.
cases.notes: ADR-048: the read-back is a statement ('Logged: ... Please review and tap submit.'); nothing is listened for after it, so there is no correction to merge. The expected location is the one the user said.

cases.transcript: Someone fell from the ladder in the store room and is bleeding.
cases.notes: Spec 13: a CARE report with nothing sent: no line may say 'notified' or 'help is on the way' (checked on every case as an invariant). The person is not named, so injured_person is asked.

cases.transcript: Something is broken in the lab.
cases.notes: Facility issue with a thin description: only the description is asked (ADR-048; no injury question without a people cue).

cases.transcript: Someone slipped near the cafeteria stairs and hurt his ankle
cases.notes: Guide row 3. Resolved: no 'when' question (no past cue). The injured person is not named, so injured_person is asked. Severity is policy-derived and not checked.

cases.transcript: Hello, can you hear me?
cases.notes: Non-incident input: description is thin and the location is missing. Location first, then the description (ADR-048); incident_type is never asked.

cases.transcript: There's a fire in the canteen kitchen, please come fast
cases.notes: Guide row 5: URGENT, emergency banner. Speak fast and urgently. The safety check is spoken once. ADR-050: injury is not asked; after the safety check the one remaining question goes to immediate_actions (severity High).

cases.transcript: Something fell off a shelf.
cases.notes: Location (missing) first, then the thin description (cap 2); both answered 'I don't know' (unknown_reporter_unsure). ADR-050: injury is never asked.

cases.transcript: I was walking along the second floor corridor in Block B when I noticed that the ceiling tiles near the pantry were wet and sagging. Then a steady stream of water started coming down onto the carpet next to the lift. It looks like a pipe above the ceiling has burst. Two colleagues from accounts, Ravi and Priya, moved the files away from the area and put out a wet floor sign. Nobody has been hurt, but the carpet is soaked and the water is close to the electrical panel. This happened at about 3:30 PM.
cases.notes: Long description (about 100 words, 35 seconds of speech): everything is in the narration, so zero follow-ups. Tests the prompt with a long transcript and the extraction of several people.

cases.transcript: Spill in the canteen.
cases.notes: A spill with the location given and a thin description: only the description is asked (ADR-048; no people cue, so no injury question).

cases.transcript: uh there's a um fire alarm going off in block b i think there is smoke near the stairs
cases.notes: Noise and fast speech. Record with loud background noise (fan, street, TV) at a fast pace, no pauses. The typed text mimics what an ASR typically returns for such audio (fillers, no punctuation, lower case). ADR-050: injury is not asked; after the safety check the one remaining question goes to immediate_actions (severity High).

cases.transcript: There is water dripping from the ceiling in conference room two.
cases.notes: Facility issue, complete enough: nothing is asked (ADR-048).

cases.transcript: The server room is overheating and the air conditioning has stopped working.

cases.transcript: Hot coffee spilled in the pantry and a colleague got burned on the hand.
cases.notes: CARE (burned). The colleague is not named, so injured_person is asked, then injury_type.

cases.transcript: A beaker broke in lab three and some liquid spilled on the table. Nobody got hurt.
cases.notes: Place name 'lab three' (Whisper may write 'lab 3' or 'lab tree'). 'broke' alone must not trigger CARE; the negation fills injury as false.

cases.transcript: I can smell gas in the canteen near the cooking area.
cases.notes: URGENT by the 'smell gas' keyword. The safety check is spoken once and 'yes, I am outside' is not extracted. ADR-050: injury is not asked; after the safety check the one remaining question goes to immediate_actions (severity High).

cases.transcript: There is a pipe leaking in front of me. I am in KRB third floor in front of CVIT.
cases.notes: Pipe leak, location given in one breath; acronyms Whisper may mishear (KRB, CVIT). Real human recording (samples/test-N.wav, 16 kHz mono, campus speaker). Reference transcript produced offline on a PC with faster-whisper small (NOT the board's ASR), so WER against it is approximate.

Photo only (ADR-062): a corroded pipe joint in an excavated trench sprays pressurised water. Ground truth: water / plumbing leak, a pressurised main is at least Medium. Nothing is said, so NOTHING may be asked, no mic, and people, injury and actions stay empty (never invent).

Photo only: the aftermath of a fire in a laboratory: a soot-blackened wall around an electrical panel, benches with glassware. Ground truth: Fire (an electrical fire is acceptable as Fire), burn damage is at least High. Nothing is asked.
Photo only: water drips from the underside of a wall-mounted split air conditioner and has stained the wall below. Ground truth: water leak (AC condensate), Low to Medium. Nothing is asked.
Photo only: flames and heavy smoke from the upper floors of a multi-storey building, firefighters spraying water. Ground truth: Fire, at least High (Critical is right). Nothing is asked.
Photo only: a wall socket with black soot and burn marks around it after a short circuit. Ground truth: Electrical Hazard, at least High. Nothing is asked.

Photo only: a bathroom floor covered in white foam spilling from the toilet. Ground truth: an overflow, a plumbing / water problem (Water Leak; Spill is the less good answer), Low to Medium. Nothing is asked.
